parsed_data.summary: Software engineer with experience in backend development, game client development, and GPU programming, complemented by a strong competitive programming background.

responsibilities_and_impact: Build robust and efficient APIs for the backend server of the supply chain team.
Worked closely with different teams to understand needs and create solutions that fit business goals.
Engaged in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-up meetings, and retrospective sessions.
Develop and maintain game clients using JavaScript and the Cocos framework for cross-platform deployment.
Collaborate with art, design, QC, and backend teams to deliver polished and engaging gameplay features.
Implement UI/UX, gameplay mechanics, and optimize client performance for smooth user experiences.
Completed intensive training on GPU programming, focusing on CUDA, HIP, and parallel computing fundamentals.
Gained hands-on experience with advanced GPU optimization techniques including memory hierarchy tuning, vectorization, and kernel fusion.
Implemented and profiled high-performance kernels for deep learning workloads on AMD MI250 GPUs using ROCm.
